title: Primary garden area minimum dimension 3 m
text: Primary garden area (applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C1.1.3 A single consolidated primary garden area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1b. Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions. Minimum dimension(2): 3m. 2 Minimum dimension refers to the minimum length and width of the primary garden area. Refer to Figure 1.1b for dimensions and calculations of primary garden areas.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding R30-R80 and R80-equivalent codes (PGA applies from R30 in Chapter 3, p10). Minimum length and width of the PGA; areas narrower than 3 m do not contribute.
